player.label: Hermes player
player.note: Some channels only allow playing on YouTube. If the player says so, use Open on YouTube.
player.larger_hint: Scale the player up (less sharp). The app gives it up to 640 × 360.
player.larger_off_hint: Back to the player at its own size (sharper)

tip.always_allow: Tip: click the ▾ next to "Load YouTube" and pick "Always allow YouTube". From then on videos open straight in the player.

next.title: Up next
next.label: Queue: up next in this list
next.end: That's the end of the queue.
next.keys: N / P to move · the next video doesn't start by itself
next.edit_keys: Drag by the handle or use Alt+↑ / Alt+↓ to reorder · Delete removes from the queue
next.empty_hint: The video stays here. Open another one from Subscriptions to start a new queue.

state.unknown_desc: We don't have the details of this video. It can still play here, or you can open it on YouTube.
state.empty_desc: Click a video in Subscriptions to watch it here.

open_mode.label: Open videos
open_mode.hermes_hint: Videos play here in HermesTube, with the Hermes player
open_mode.youtube_hint: Videos open on YouTube, in your browser
